CMKPipeCreateImage.description: Central entry point for Text2Image and Inpaint. Defines the task, image, mask, and prompts and prepares the complete process for the rest of the flow.
features: Choose Text2Image or Inpaint as the process
Prepare Inpaint tasks such as Replace, Remove, Extend, and Custom
Provide the image, mask, and prompts centrally for the downstream flow
CMKPipeCreateImage.placementNote: Place as the central starting module before optional ControlNet or the first KSampler. Connect IMAGE and MASK for Inpaint; Remove Object only requires the mask.

CMKRegionalConditioningSDXL.description: Adds up to three spatially limited prompt regions to the global SDXL conditioning.
features: Use up to three independently controlled regions
Use standard presets for position and area of effect
Set the position, strength, and duration of each region individually
CMKRegionalConditioningSDXL.placementNote: Place directly after 01 START HERE and before optional ControlNet or 10 KSampler SDXL.

CMKCheckpointVAELoaderPipe.previewAlt: CMK Flow Checkpoint and VAE node
CMKCheckpointVAELoaderPipe.description: Selects the image model and matching image decoder.
features: Provides the model for a sampler or refiner
CMKCheckpointVAELoaderPipe.placementNote: Place before the KSampler or Refiner and connect MODEL to its MODEL input.

CMKLoadImage.description: Loads an image into the flow without modifying it.
features: Compact image loader without resizing
CMKLoadImage.placementNote: Place before a module that processes an existing image.

CMKImageLoadAndResizePipe.description: Loads an image, adjusts it to the desired working size, and starts a family-neutral PROCESS path for direct standalone postprocessing.
CMKImageLoadAndResizePipe.highlight: Not a Flow generation module. Use CMK Flow · Load Image when the image must enter SDXL inpaint before sampling.
features: Load an image
Prepare size and orientation for the flow
Connect directly to Detailer, FaceRebuild, or FaceProcess without prior sampling
Distribute the selected image path centrally to identity modules through image_file
CMKImageLoadAndResizePipe.placementNote: Place at the beginning of an image-based standalone flow directly before a family-neutral postprocess module.

CMKSwapImageLoaderPipe.previewAlt: CMK Flow FaceSwap Image Input with target and source image selection
CMKSwapImageLoaderPipe.description: Loads target and source images for FaceSwap.
features: Prepares both required images together

CMKImageFileLoader.description: Provides a selected image file as a technical file reference for CMK workflows.
features: Select an image file
Output a technical file reference

CMKControlNetPreparePipe.description: Optionally adds image guidance for the following generation step.
features: Uses composition or contours of an image as guidance
CMKControlNetPreparePipe.placementNote: Place between Create Image and the first KSampler. Omit it when no image guidance is needed.

CMKZITControlNetPreparePipe.description: Optionally adds Canny image guidance for ZIT.
features: Uses image contours as structural guidance for ZIT
CMKZITControlNetPreparePipe.placementNote: Place between Create Image and the ZIT KSampler. Omit it when no image guidance is needed.

CMKFamilyResultMergePipe.description: Ends the active SDXL, ZIT, or HYBRID generation path and provides an independent working context for downstream PostProcess modules.
features: Accept only the active generation branch
Pass its result to PostProcess
Load a separate PostProcess model only when needed
CMKFamilyResultMergePipe.placementNote: Use the Combined variant immediately after the final SDXL and ZIT generation stages and before Detailer, FaceRebuild, or FaceProcess. Model-free paths do not materialize the configured postprocess model.

CMKPostProcessBoundarySDXLPipe.description: Ends a pure SDXL generation path and provides an independent working context for downstream PostProcess modules.
features: Pass the generated image to PostProcess
Release the SDXL generation model
Load a separate PostProcess model only when needed
CMKPostProcessBoundarySDXLPipe.placementNote: Place directly after the final SDXL generation module and before Detailer, FaceRebuild, or FaceProcess.

CMKPostProcessBoundaryZITPipe.description: Ends a pure Z-Image Turbo generation path and provides an independent working context for downstream PostProcess modules.
features: Pass the generated image to PostProcess
Release the ZIT generation model
Load a separate PostProcess model only when needed
CMKPostProcessBoundaryZITPipe.placementNote: Place directly after the ZIT finalizer and before compatible Detailer, FaceRebuild, or FaceProcess.

CMKInstantIDSamplerSDXLPipe.description: Continues the SDXL sampling started by module 10 on the same sigma schedule and applies InstantID while preserving the established composition.
features: Select the source face inside the module
Control identity attention and InstantID ControlNet strength separately
Continue the noisy layout latent without adding new noise
Use the separate clean x0 estimate for InstantID keypoints
Inherit steps, handoff step, seed, sampler, scheduler, and denoise from module 10
CMKInstantIDSamplerSDXLPipe.placementNote: Place directly after 10 KSampler SDXL 1st Pass and before 20 Refiner SDXL.
CMKInstantIDSamplerSDXLPipe.dependencyNote: Requires antelopev2, the InstantID IP-Adapter model, and the matching InstantID SDXL ControlNet model.

CMKInstantIDFaceRebuildPrepare.description: Detects the largest target face and prepares a local head/neck ROI with separate reconstruction and final pasteback masks.
features: Uses the existing InsightFace detector
Keeps the neck as generation context while final neck pasteback is independently switchable and off by default
Creates deterministic edge-clipped geometry
Scales the ROI to an SDXL-ready working resolution
CMKInstantIDFaceRebuildPrepare.placementNote: Place before the existing Inpaint Hybrid path and route the target ROI and mask through module 10 and InstantID module 15.
CMKInstantIDFaceRebuildPrepare.dependencyNote: Requires an InsightFace analysis model; antelopev2 is recommended.

CMKInstantIDFaceRebuildPasteback.description: Returns the rebuilt ROI to the unchanged target and verifies that no pixel outside the final mask support changed.
features: Restores the original ROI size
Composites only inside the explicit pasteback mask
Reports the outside-mask integrity result
CMKInstantIDFaceRebuildPasteback.placementNote: Place after decoding the module 15 result and connect the original target, pasteback mask, and rebuild context from Prepare.

CMKInstantIDFaceRebuildPreparePipe.description: Inserts Face Rebuild after module 01 while preserving the canonical CMK PROCESS, IMAGE, and LOG flow order.
features: Copies and configures the SDXL process for Inpaint Hybrid
Outputs PROCESS, IMAGE, and LOG for direct module 10 wiring
Leaves Source Face exclusively to module 15's internal picker
CMKInstantIDFaceRebuildPreparePipe.placementNote: Insert after 01 START HERE and before 10 KSampler SDXL; select Source Face in the visible module 15.

CMKInstantIDFaceRebuildPastebackPipe.description: Rejoins the rebuilt head ROI with the canonical CMK MODEL, PROCESS, IMAGE, and LOG contract.
features: Passes MODEL and PROCESS through unchanged
Returns the verified pasteback as the canonical IMAGE
Appends the integrity result to the canonical LOG
CMKInstantIDFaceRebuildPastebackPipe.placementNote: Insert after the decoded InstantID result and continue with the next CMK image module.

CMKInstantIDFaceDetailerSDXL.description: Rebuilds a local target ROI as a regular InstantID Img2Img detailer without Fooocus Inpaint, a first pass, or a handoff bridge.
features: Uses the VAE-encoded target ROI as the direct Img2Img latent
Uses the unchanged target ROI directly for KPS
Adds noise at an absolute sampling start step
Does not change or depend on module 15 orchestration
CMKInstantIDFaceDetailerSDXL.placementNote: Use between Face Rebuild Prepare and Pasteback with a CMK checkpoint MODEL and a separate Source Face.

CMKVisualizer.previewAlt: CMK Flow · Visualizer as the central visual workspace for CMK Flow 2.0
CMKVisualizer.description: Displays the processing stages registered in the VISUAL pipe and can optionally upscale and save the final image.
features: Display all registered processing stages in one place and optionally upscale and save the final image
CMKVisualizer.placementNote: CMK Visualizer is the mandatory final stage of every CMK Flow chain. Connect VISUAL together with the final result pipes from the preceding module.

CMK_SaveProjectImage.description: Saves the finished image with a project name and optional date folder.
features: Saves the result at the end of processing
CMK_SaveProjectImage.placementNote: Place after the desired image processing as the final module.

CMK Flow · 02 SDXL LoRA Stack.description: Combines multiple LoRAs into a clear stack for the following flow.
features: Build a LoRA stack
Weight multiple LoRAs
Prepare the prompt for the flow
CMK Flow · 02 SDXL LoRA Stack.placementNote: Use as a standalone loader before the model and sampling section when combining one or more SDXL LoRAs into a stack.

0edf7a0d-3271-4b2e-8344-72d3506bb628.description: Guides image generation with a reference image, transferring its spatial or structural cues to the new image.
features: Transfer the structure and composition of a reference image to the generation
Set the strength and duration of the reference guidance
Show the processed ControlNet reference in the Visualizer
0edf7a0d-3271-4b2e-8344-72d3506bb628.info: The reference dimensions determine the output resolution.

96aabb3d-a0c9-4539-86c0-2b2a7abb0712.description: Guides image generation with a reference image, transferring its spatial or structural cues to the new image.
features: Transfer the structure and composition of a reference image to the generation
Set the strength and duration of the reference guidance
Show the processed ControlNet reference in the Visualizer
96aabb3d-a0c9-4539-86c0-2b2a7abb0712.info: The reference dimensions determine the output resolution.

aeec8af2-85bf-4969-8743-9b39bb5483ef.description: Guides image generation with a reference image, transferring its spatial or structural cues to the new image.
features: Transfer the structure and composition of a reference image to the generation
Set the strength and duration of the reference guidance
Show the processed ControlNet reference in the Visualizer
aeec8af2-85bf-4969-8743-9b39bb5483ef.info: The reference dimensions determine the output resolution.

f1cd74c6-da65-40cb-91b5-2e27d16a4c04.description: Reconstructs a selected target face from scratch and composites the edited area back into the otherwise unchanged image.
features: Fully reconstruct a selected target face
Limit the reconstruction to the face area
Composite the edited area back into the source image
f1cd74c6-da65-40cb-91b5-2e27d16a4c04.info: Include the neck area in the reconstruction if needed.

ffd2127b-6fcf-4ea8-ad8c-e259b8653e40.description: Reconstructs up to three target faces independently and composites each area back into the unchanged image.
features: Reconstruct up to three faces separately
Use separate settings for each face
Composite the reconstructed areas back into the source image independently
ffd2127b-6fcf-4ea8-ad8c-e259b8653e40.info: Include the neck areas in the reconstruction if needed.

5e25c315-1e30-4fca-af11-db30118b807e.description: Selectively and repeatably refines a manually masked image area without regenerating the rest of the image.
features: Define the image area manually with a mask
Repeatedly edit the frozen source image with a modified mask
Automatically bind the edit to a new upstream state
5e25c315-1e30-4fca-af11-db30118b807e.info: When processing starts, the current image is frozen. Further runs use this image until the input changes.

29d596c9-48b8-4cf5-aa02-e1c50d125712.description: Bundles SDXL-compatible LoRAs and their trigger words for the SDXL generation path.
features: Accept only SDXL-compatible LoRAs
Bundle the associated trigger words
Provide the LoRA stack for the SDXL generation path

ee158dd0-99a8-40b2-8ea8-142b79368125.description: Bundles Z-Image-Turbo-compatible LoRAs and their trigger words for the Z-Image Turbo generation path.
features: Accept only Z-Image-Turbo-compatible LoRAs
Bundle the associated trigger words
Provide the LoRA stack for the Z-Image Turbo generation path

c1b3b220-bc27-479a-ae12-a43e226d96e3.previewAlt: CMK Flow Detailer with one Detailer branch
c1b3b220-bc27-479a-ae12-a43e226d96e3.description: Automatically detects and segments a relevant image area using the selected models, then refines it selectively.
features: Automatically detect and segment a relevant image area
Selectively refine the detected area
Use detection and segmentation models to select the area
c1b3b220-bc27-479a-ae12-a43e226d96e3.placementNote: Place on the family-neutral postprocess path after the PostProcess Boundary. The working model is SDXL/PonyXL; use with ZIT or Hybrid images only after qualitative approval.

761fe2bd-e305-4adf-898d-54f87d99fd57.description: Independently detects and segments up to three relevant image areas and refines each one selectively.
features: Detect and segment up to three image areas separately
Refine each area independently
Use separate settings for each area
761fe2bd-e305-4adf-898d-54f87d99fd57.placementNote: Place on the family-neutral postprocess path after the PostProcess Boundary. The working model is SDXL/PonyXL; use with ZIT or Hybrid images only after qualitative approval.
761fe2bd-e305-4adf-898d-54f87d99fd57.dependencyNote: Each branch needs a suitable detector model for its intended image area.

9993a5f9-7cd5-431c-8653-6e187ef9d214.description: Replaces a selected face in the target image with the identity of a reference face.
features: Replace one target face with a reference face
Automatically align and fit the face to the target image
Leave the rest of the image unchanged
9993a5f9-7cd5-431c-8653-6e187ef9d214.placementNote: Shared family-neutral module. Place after the PostProcess Boundary and any model-dependent postprocess modules, then continue to Upscale & Save.

062af015-5929-4d94-86bd-fd060f67ee53.description: Performs up to three independent FaceSwaps in a single pass.
features: Replace up to three target faces separately
Use a separate reference for each swap
Process multiple faces independently in a single pass
062af015-5929-4d94-86bd-fd060f67ee53.placementNote: Shared family-neutral module. Place after the PostProcess Boundary and any model-dependent postprocess modules, then continue to Upscale & Save.
062af015-5929-4d94-86bd-fd060f67ee53.dependencyNote: Select a separate source image for every FaceSwap branch in use.

0a3f7a10-a21c-49ed-9faa-7e55e7b7a4dd.description: Processes either one selected face or all detected faces in Detailer or Restore mode.
features: Process one selected face or all detected faces
Choose between Detailer and Restore
Process faces locally without regenerating the rest of the image
0a3f7a10-a21c-49ed-9faa-7e55e7b7a4dd.placementNote: Place on the family-neutral postprocess path after the PostProcess Boundary. Restore mode remains model-free; Detailer mode requests the dedicated SDXL/PonyXL postprocess model.

cec036fc-09d6-4f44-b564-4692ea7051a0.description: Processes up to three selected faces independently, or all detected faces, in Detailer or Restore mode.
features: Process up to three selected faces or all detected faces
Choose between Detailer and Restore
Process faces locally without regenerating the rest of the image
cec036fc-09d6-4f44-b564-4692ea7051a0.placementNote: Place on the family-neutral postprocess path after the PostProcess Boundary. Restore branches remain model-free; Detailer branches request the dedicated SDXL/PonyXL postprocess model.
cec036fc-09d6-4f44-b564-4692ea7051a0.dependencyNote: Each branch independently selects its target face and processing mode.

6f8d63a4-7ea5-4c18-9900-2ec3ed33c9b6.previewAlt: Upscale & Save as a flow-compatible saving side branch
features: Save the current image
6f8d63a4-7ea5-4c18-9900-2ec3ed33c9b6.placementNote: Place once at the end of the common image-processing chain, directly before the mandatory Visualizer.

1c91adfd-df9f-4729-90a1-35dc53915ca6.description: Transfers the identity of a reference face to the generated person and continues the existing SDXL image build with identity guidance.
features: Use a reference face as the identity guide
Adjust identity and pose weights separately
Continue the existing SDXL image build with InstantID
1c91adfd-df9f-4729-90a1-35dc53915ca6.placementNote: Place after 10 KSampler SDXL 1st Pass and before 20 Refiner SDXL.
1c91adfd-df9f-4729-90a1-35dc53915ca6.dependencyNote: Requires antelopev2, the InstantID IP-Adapter model, and the matching InstantID SDXL ControlNet model.

e371220c-caba-4cfd-ae2b-81e59664d525.description: Creates the first SDXL image pass, handling both Text2Image and the prepared Inpaint tasks.
features: Generate the first SDXL image pass
Run Text2Image and prepared Inpaint tasks
Control the strength and influence of the first pass
e371220c-caba-4cfd-ae2b-81e59664d525.placementNote: Place after Create Image and optional ControlNet. Connect the selected model to MODEL.
e371220c-caba-4cfd-ae2b-81e59664d525.dependencyNote: Connect SAMPLED to the Refiner input with the same name.

featureCallout.title: Supports both Text2Image and Inpaint
featureCallout.text: A single sampler module for both processes – works with any compatible SDXL checkpoint. No specialized checkpoints required.

92cbb212-4e34-4b9a-8aa7-903d96ce39f2.description: Generates images directly with Z-Image Turbo and also supports experimental masked inpainting.
features: Generate Text2Image with Z-Image Turbo
Use fast 8-step Turbo sampling
Run experimental masked inpainting
92cbb212-4e34-4b9a-8aa7-903d96ce39f2.info: Z-Image Turbo inpainting is still under development.
92cbb212-4e34-4b9a-8aa7-903d96ce39f2.placementNote: Place after 01 or the optional ZIT ControlNet. Continue through PostProcess Boundary ZIT or Combined before entering the common postprocess path.

79b164c2-6919-4e9f-81aa-c14469d1715f.description: Refines the SDXL result in a second sampling stage and inherits the prompt and sampling settings from the first pass by default.
features: Refine the SDXL result in a second pass
Inherit the prompt and sampling settings from the first pass
Allow fine-tuning independently of LoRA inheritance
79b164c2-6919-4e9f-81aa-c14469d1715f.placementNote: Place directly after 10 KSampler SDXL 1st Pass. Continue through PostProcess Boundary SDXL or Combined before entering the common postprocess path.
79b164c2-6919-4e9f-81aa-c14469d1715f.dependencyNote: SAMPLED, MODEL, and PROCESS come from the corresponding outputs of the preceding modules.

57da8c95-878c-4e93-a016-5da4c700e9ca.description: Bundles SDXL- and Z-Image-Turbo-compatible LoRAs and their trigger words for both generation paths.
features: Accept SDXL- and Z-Image-Turbo-compatible LoRAs
Bundle trigger words separately for both model families
Provide separate LoRA stacks for both generation paths
57da8c95-878c-4e93-a016-5da4c700e9ca.placementNote: Place in the preprocess section and connect both LoRA outputs to the corresponding inputs of module 01.

toolbox.CMKMaskDetailerPrepare: Prepares the model, painted image mask, optional LoRA, and prompt addition for the standalone CMK Mask Detailer.
toolbox.CMKMaskDetailerProcess: Refines only the regions masked in CMK Load Image and forwards MODEL, image, LOG, and VISUAL to the Visualizer.
toolbox.CMKDetailerPreparePipe: Prepares the model, image regions, and settings for an SDXL detailer pass.
toolbox.CMKFaceProcessPreparePipe: Detects and selects target faces and prepares them for a FaceProcess branch.
toolbox.CMKFaceProcessPipe: Runs the configured face processing and returns processed image regions and log data.
toolbox.CMKFaceSwapImagePipe: Replaces a selected face in the target image with the identity from a source image and returns the processed regions.
toolbox.CMKKSamplerPipe: Runs the prepared SDXL sampling job and passes on the latent, preview image, and sampling data.
toolbox.CMKRefinerPrepareSDXLPipe: Prepares the model, prompt inheritance, and sampling parameters for an SDXL refiner pass.
toolbox.CMKRefinerPipe: Runs the prepared SDXL refiner pass and decodes both the first-pass and refined results.
toolbox.CMKSamplerPrepareSDXLPipe: Builds the complete first-pass SDXL sampling job from the model, PROCESS, and conditioning.
toolbox.CMKSamplerPrepareZImageTurboPipe: Prepares conditioning, latent data, and sampling parameters for Z-Image Turbo.
toolbox.CMKZImageTurboLoaderPipe: Loads the components of a Z-Image Turbo model for the subsequent sampling setup.
toolbox.CMKZImageTurboFinalizePipe: Decodes the Z-Image Turbo result and returns the image, PROCESS, and log to the shared result path.
toolbox.CMK_SmartDetailerPipe: Runs CMK Smart Detailer inside a connectable PROCESS branch.
toolbox.CMK_SmartUpscalerPipe: Upscales an image inside a connectable PROCESS branch using CMK Smart Upscaler settings.
toolbox.CMKSwapImageLoaderPipe: Loads the target and source images for the standalone CMK FaceSwap Video workflow. This node belongs in the Toolbox because it cannot be inserted into the canonical CMK Flow wiring.
toolbox.CMKDiagnosticConcat: Appends up to 32 complete CMK diagnostics in input order for Preview Render, Summary, or Preview Board.
toolbox.CMKPreviewBoard: Combines up to 32 CMK diagnostics into one visual overview and places multiple processing stages directly beside each other.
toolbox.CMKPreviewRender: Turns one CMK diagnostic into a complete visual process view with intermediate images, captions, and the decisive settings.
toolbox.CMKSummary: Condenses a CMK diagnostic into a clear summary of the processing performed, its settings, and its result.
toolbox.CMKLogCreate: Creates an empty CMK log pipe for structured workflow messages.
toolbox.CMKLogSetBlock: Adds a named and sortable text block to a CMK log pipe.
toolbox.CMKLogConcat: Combines up to 32 log blocks in an existing CMK log pipe.
toolbox.CMKLogExportText: Sorts a CMK log pipe and exports its complete content as readable text.
toolbox.CMK_ImageMetrics: Reads image dimensions, batch size, and channels and also provides them as a CMK diagnostic.
toolbox.CMK_ImageQuickMetrics: Shows key image and tensor values directly in the node and passes the image through unchanged.
toolbox.CMKCheckpointVAELoader: Loads an SDXL checkpoint together with CLIP and VAE for standalone workflows outside the canonical CMK pipe flow.
toolbox.CMKControlNetPrepare: Loads a ControlNet model, prepares the guidance image, and builds conditioning for a standalone ControlNet step.
toolbox.CMK_EmptyImageMask: Creates an empty image and matching mask at a selectable size as a starting point for image and mask workflows.
toolbox.CMKFaceCrop: Crops detected face regions from an image and returns them separately for targeted processing.
toolbox.CMKFaceMask: Creates a mask from detected face regions for local face processing and pasteback.
toolbox.CMKFaceRestore: Restores detected faces with the selected restoration model and composites them back into the image.
toolbox.CMKFaceSelect: Selects target persons from detected faces by position or sequence.
toolbox.CMK_FaceProcess: Combines selection, masking, and restoration of detected faces into a standalone FaceProcess step.
toolbox.CMKFaceSwapImage: Transfers the identity of a source face to selected faces in a single target image.
toolbox.CMKFaceSwapVideo: Transfers the identity of a source face to selected faces across a video frame sequence.
toolbox.CMKFaceSwapVideoLoader: Loads a video as a frame sequence and provides the video data required by the standalone FaceSwap Video workflow.
toolbox.CMK_FilenameBase: Builds a consistent base filename from project and file information for downstream save nodes.
toolbox.CMK_ImageMaskSwitch: Switches image and mask together between two input paths and keeps both data streams synchronized.
toolbox.CMKLoRAStackBuilder: Builds a stack from multiple selectable LoRAs with separate model and CLIP strengths.
toolbox.CMKLoRATextLoader: Reads a text-based LoRA list and provides it for building a LoRA stack.
toolbox.CMKMergeAndSaveVideo: Merges processed video segments and saves the finished video with the selected output settings.
toolbox.CMKStringDual: Provides two separate text values, typically positive and negative prompts for standalone workflows.
toolbox.CMK_SEGSConcate: Combines multiple detected-region collections into one SEGS structure for further detail processing.
toolbox.CMK_SaveProjectText: Saves text content under a project-based, consistently constructed filename.
toolbox.CMK_SaveProjectVideo: Saves a video with project-based naming and the available metadata.
toolbox.CMK_SmartDetailer: Detects selected image regions and improves them using configurable inpaint sampling and masked compositing.
toolbox.CMK_SmartOutpaintPad: Expands an image canvas and creates the matching mask for subsequent outpainting.
toolbox.CMK_SmartUpscaler: Upscales images with a selectable model and controlled target size for final output.
toolbox.CMK_SourcePathInfo: Splits a source path into reusable directory, file, and name components.
toolbox.CMKSplitVideoIntoSegments: Splits a video into separately processable sections and frame sequences using the selected segmentation settings.
toolbox.CMK_VideoMetrics: Reads technical video properties and provides them for diagnostics and logging.
toolbox.CMK_VideoQuickMetrics: Shows the most important technical video values directly in the node.
toolbox.CMKVideoCompare: Compares video or segment data and prepares the detected differences for diagnostics and logging.
